map.多标准结果互通：同一胶料常需同时满足阿克隆（GB/T 1689）、DIN 535: Results interoperate across standards: the same rubber compound often needs reports meeting several abrasion standards at once, such as Akron (GB/T 1689), DIN 53516 (German) and Grasselli, and the tool converts between them by coefficients for easy comparison and for converting foreign trade orders.
map.是。磨耗值表示单位里程/时间的体积损失，数值越小代表胶料越耐磨；但过小可能牺牲抓: Yes. The abrasion value represents the volume loss per unit distance or time, and a smaller value means the compound is more wear-resistant; but too small a value may sacrifice grip, elasticity and other properties, so it must be judged together with tensile, tear and hardness results.
map.橡胶磨耗测试标准对照 使用指南: Rubber Abrasion Test Standards Comparison Guide
map.浏览阿克隆、格拉西尔、DIN 等常见橡胶磨耗测试标准，工具对照各方法的试样、滚筒: Browse common rubber abrasion test standards such as Akron, Grasselli and DIN; the tool compares the specimen, drum conditions and result conventions of each method and provides a conversion reference for the abrasion volume between standards, which helps quality inspection and material selection.
map.磨耗值越小越耐磨吗？: Does a Smaller Abrasion Value Mean Better Wear Resistance?
map.第三方报告复核：收到 DIN 或格拉西尔报告时反算阿克隆值，可快速判断是否满足内: Third-party report review: when a DIN or Grasselli report arrives, back out the Akron value to quickly see whether the internal control threshold is met, avoiding misjudgements caused by confusing units and standards.
map.配方耐磨性评估：以阿克隆磨耗值定级，≤0.1 极好、≤0.2 良好、≤0.4 一: Formulation wear-resistance assessment: grade by the Akron abrasion value, ≤0.1 excellent, ≤0.2 good, ≤0.4 fair, guiding tread and conveyor belt formulation adjustment.
map.阿克隆以体积损失 / 1.61km 行程计（cm³/1.61km），DIN 以体: Akron measures the volume loss per 1.61 km of travel (cm³/1.61km), DIN measures the volume loss (mm³), and Grasselli measures the volume loss per unit time (cm³/h); the three use different machines, abrasives and loads, so only an approximate conversion factor is given and an exact comparison requires retesting under the same standard.
